headlines.title: 中国机电商会：支持商务部对相关产品启动对外贸易国家安全调查
headlines.summary: 中国机电产品进出口商会发布声明称，2026年8月5日，商务部发布公告，对相关进口打印复印办公设备启动对外贸易国家安全调查。中国机电商会高度关注，坚决支持商务部依法启动调查，评估相关进口对我对外贸易中国家安全利益的影响并视情出台必要措施。 中国机电商会注意到，近期美国联邦通信委员会和美国国土安全部出台系列涉华消极措施，包括多项限制性市场准入措施，性质极为恶劣。同时，美国政府泛化国家安全概念，甚至将木材等常规产品纳入232调查，并滥施关税。中国机电商会对此坚决反对。

headlines.title_en: China Chamber of Commerce for Import and Export of Machinery and Electronic Products supports the Ministry of Commerce's launch of national security investigations into foreign trade for related products.
headlines.summary_en: The China Chamber of Commerce for Import and Export of Machinery and Electronic Products issued a statement saying that on August 5, 2026, the Ministry of Commerce announced the launch of a national security investigation into imports of printing, copying and office equipment. The chamber expressed strong support for the Ministry of Commerce's lawful initiation of the investigation to assess the impact of such imports on national security interests in foreign trade and to take necessary measures as appropriate. The chamber noted that the U.S. Federal Communications Commission and the U.S. Department of Homeland Security have recently introduced a series of negative measures targeting China, including multiple restrictive market access measures, which are extremely恶劣 in nature. At the same time, the U.S. government has overgeneralized the national security concept, even including ordinary products such as timber in Section 232 investigations, and has滥施 tariffs. The chamber firmly opposes these actions.

headlines.title_en: *ST Zhuoran: Receives regulatory work letter from Shanghai Stock Exchange, suspected of false disclosure which may trigger mandatory delisting for major violations.
headlines.summary_en: *ST Zhuoran announced that on August 5, 2026, it received a regulatory work letter from the Shanghai Stock Exchange. The CSRC Shanghai Bureau has preliminarily found that certain annual financial information disclosed by the company is suspected of containing false records, which may trigger mandatory delisting for major violations. In addition, the company's 2025 annual financial report was issued with a disclaimer of opinion audit report, and its internal control was issued with an adverse opinion audit report.

headlines.title: 广州有银行住房商贷利率最低可至2.7% 分析人士：更像针对特定人群的“价格战”
headlines.summary: 目前多数城市已经取消了住房贷款利率下限，但仍维持在3%以上。广州此前便有银行将住房贷款下调至3%以下，随后均又调回3%。不过，汇丰银行广州分行称，住房贷款利率最低可至2.7%。“未来银行个人住房贷款利率大体上也不会降，3%基本上是底线了，只能说只针对部分特定客户可以给到2.7%。”上海易居房地产研究院副院长严跃进对记者表示，此类最低利率门槛很高，并非人人都能享受，更像是一种针对特定人群的“价格战”。（每经）

headlines.title_en: A bank in Guangzhou offers minimum commercial housing loan rate of 2.7%; analysts say it resembles a 'price war' targeting specific groups.
headlines.summary_en: Currently, most cities have lifted the lower limit on housing loan interest rates, but they remain above 3%. In Guangzhou, some banks previously cut housing loans below 3%, but later adjusted them back to 3%. However, HSBC's Guangzhou branch said housing loan rates can be as low as 2.7%. 'In the future, banks' personal housing loan rates will generally not drop either; 3% is basically the bottom line. It can only be said that 2.7% is available to certain specific customers only,' said Yan Yuejin, vice president of Shanghai E-house Real Estate Research Institute. He noted that such minimum rates have high thresholds and are not accessible to everyone, more like a 'price war' targeting specific groups. (NBD)

headlines.summary: 财政部拟发行2026年记账式贴现（四十八期）国债。本期国债为期限91天的贴现债。本期国债竞争性招标面值总额300亿元，进行甲类成员追加投标。本期国债发行价格通过竞争性招标确定，以低于票面金额的价格贴现发行。本期国债自2026年8月6日开始计息，于2026年11月5日（节假日顺延）按面值偿还。(财政部)

headlines.title_en: Issuance of 2026 book-entry discount Treasury bonds (48th tranche).
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance plans to issue the 2026 book-entry discount treasury bond (48th issue). This bond is a 91-day discount bond with a competitive bidding face value of 300 billion yuan, allowing Class A members to make additional bids. The issue price will be determined through competitive bidding, and the bond will be issued at a discount below par value. Interest on this bond will accrue from August 6, 2026, and it will be redeemed at par value on November 5, 2026 (subject to holiday adjustment). (Ministry of Finance)

headlines.title: 2026年下半年中国人民银行广东省分行工作会议暨广东外汇管理工作会议召开
headlines.summary: 8月4日，中国人民银行广东省分行召开2026年下半年工作会议暨广东外汇管理工作会议。会议强调，要继续落实适度宽松的货币政策，助力广东经济稳住增长势头；加力支持重点领域和薄弱环节，提升金融服务实体经济质效；续深化外汇管理改革，提升跨境贸易投融资便利化水平；充分发挥维护金融稳定和宏观审慎管理职能，守牢不发生系统性金融风险的底线。会议要求，一是推进外汇领域制度型开放，促进贸易投融资便利化。二是大力优化外汇服务，助力涉外经济高质量发展。三是强化外汇业务监管，筑牢外部冲击防波堤防浪堤。

headlines.title_en: The PBOC Guangdong Branch held its H2 2026 work conference and Guangdong foreign exchange administration work meeting.
headlines.summary_en: On August 4, the Guangdong Provincial Branch of the People's Bank of China held its 2026 mid-year work conference and Guangdong foreign exchange management work conference. The meeting emphasized continuing to implement a moderately loose monetary policy to help Guangdong's economy maintain its growth momentum; intensifying support for key areas and weak links to improve the effectiveness of financial services to the real economy; continuing to deepen foreign exchange management reforms to enhance the convenience of cross-border trade and investment financing; and fully exercising functions of maintaining financial stability and macro-prudential management to firmly guard the bottom line of preventing systemic financial risks. The meeting required: first, advancing institutional opening-up in the foreign exchange field to promote trade and investment financing facilitation; second, vigorously optimizing foreign exchange services to support high-quality development of the foreign-related economy; third, strengthening foreign exchange business supervision to build a breakwater against external shocks.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Decision to take countermeasures against a US compliance testing company.
headlines.summary_en: Approved by the national coordination mechanism for countering foreign sanctions, the 'Decision on Taking Countermeasures Against U.S. Compliance Testing Company' is hereby published, effective from August 5, 2026. Recently, the U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has intensively introduced negative measures targeting China, seriously infringing upon the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese enterprises. U.S. Compliance Testing Company assisted and supported the FCC in taking these measures, harming China's sovereignty, security and development interests.

headlines.summary: 商务部发布关于对应用DNA科学公司等6家美国实体采取反制措施的决定。近期，美国以所谓“强迫劳动”为由制裁中国企业，严重违反国际法和国际关系基本准则，严重侵犯我国主权、安全、发展利益。应用DNA科学公司等6家美国实体协助、支持美国涉疆非法制裁，性质恶劣。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Countermeasures against six US entities including Applied DNA Sciences.
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce issued a decision on taking countermeasures against six U.S. entities including Applied DNA Sciences. Recently, the United States has sanctioned Chinese enterprises under the pretext of so-called 'forced labor,' seriously violating international law and basic norms of international relations, and seriously infringing upon China's sovereignty, security and development interests. The six U.S. entities, including Applied DNA Sciences, assisted and supported the U.S.'s illegal sanctions related to Xinjiang, which is of an egregious nature.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce spokesperson answers questions on countermeasures against a series of negative China-related actions by the US Federal Communications Commission and US Department of Homeland Security.
headlines.summary_en: The measures taken by the U.S. Federal Communications Commission and the U.S. Department of Homeland Security's inclusion of relevant entities in the so-called 'Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act Entity List' seriously violate the important consensus reached by the two heads of state and seriously harm China's legitimate rights and interests. China has no choice but to take necessary countermeasures in response, including: strengthening export controls on UAV and their key components and technologies to the U.S., suspending factory follow-up inspections conducted by U.S. certification bodies entrusted by China's compulsory product certification designated agencies, placing U.S. Compliance Testing Company on the countermeasures list, launching a foreign trade national security investigation into imports of printing, copying and office equipment, and placing six U.S. entities on the countermeasures list.

headlines.title: 百济神州：预计2026年度营业收入上调为449亿至462亿元
headlines.summary: 百济神州公告，调整2026年度经营业绩预测：预计2026年度营业收入介于人民币449亿元至462亿元（调整前为436亿元至452亿元）；营业收入扣除经营成本费用预计介于65亿元至71亿元（调整前为48亿元至55亿元）；营业收入扣除经调整的经营成本费用预计介于115亿元至122亿元（调整前为100亿元至106亿元）。调整主要得益于百悦泽在美国市场的领先地位及欧洲和全球其他重要市场持续扩张。

headlines.title_en: BeiGene: Expected 2026 revenue raised to RMB 44.9-46.2 billion.
headlines.summary_en: BeiGene announced an adjustment to its 2026 operating performance forecast: expected 2026 operating revenue of RMB 44.9 billion to RMB 46.2 billion (previously RMB 43.6 billion to RMB 45.2 billion); operating revenue after deducting operating costs and expenses of RMB 6.5 billion to RMB 7.1 billion (previously RMB 4.8 billion to RMB 5.5 billion); operating revenue after deducting adjusted operating costs and expenses of RMB 11.5 billion to RMB 12.2 billion (previously RMB 10 billion to RMB 10.6 billion). The adjustment is mainly attributed to Brukinsa's leading position in the U.S. market and continued expansion in Europe and other key global markets.

headlines.title: 晶丰明源：拟以6000万元-1.2亿元回购公司股份
headlines.summary: 晶丰明源公告，拟以不低于人民币6000万元（含）且不超过人民币1.2亿元（含）回购公司股份，回购价格不超过239.71元/股。本次回购的股份将全部用于维护公司价值及股东权益，资金来源为自有资金和股票回购专项贷款，回购期限自董事会审议通过之日起3个月内。

headlines.title_en: Bright Power Semiconductor: Plans to repurchase company shares for RMB 60-120 million.
headlines.summary_en: Bright Power Semiconductor announced plans to repurchase its shares for no less than RMB 60 million (inclusive) and no more than RMB 120 million (inclusive), with a repurchase price not exceeding RMB 239.71 per share. The repurchased shares will all be used to maintain corporate value and protect shareholders' interests, with funding from自有 funds and special loans for stock repurchases, and the repurchase period is within 3 months from the date of board approval.

headlines.title_en: Southbound capital net sell-off of 1.398 billion yuan today
headlines.summary_en: Southbound capital recorded a net sell of RMB 1.398 billion today. On the Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect, Tracker Fund and Tencent Holdings saw net sells of HK$2.031 billion and HK$0.69 billion respectively; SMIC ranked first in net buying with HK$309 million. On the Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect, Tencent Holdings and CNOOC saw net sells of HK$775 million and HK$617 million respectively; SMIC ranked first in net buying with HK$843 million.

headlines.title: 商务部：对相关进口打印复印办公设备发起对外贸易国家安全立案调查
headlines.summary: 依据《中华人民共和国对外贸易法》第四十一条规定，为了维护对外贸易秩序，商务部可以自行或者会同国务院其他有关部门，就对外贸易中有关国家安全利益的事项进行调查。初步信息显示，装有外国系统软件的进口打印复印办公设备可能影响对外贸易中的国家安全利益，符合《中华人民共和国对外贸易法》第四十一条规定的情形。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Launch national security investigation into imports of related printing, copying, and office equipment
headlines.summary_en: Pursuant to Article 41 of the Foreign Trade Law of the People's Republic of China, in order to maintain foreign trade order, the Ministry of Commerce may, on its own or jointly with other relevant departments of the State Council, investigate matters concerning national security interests in foreign trade. Preliminary information shows that imported printing, copying and office equipment installed with foreign system software may affect national security interests in foreign trade, meeting the circumstances stipulated in Article 41 of the Foreign Trade Law of the People's Republic of China.

headlines.title: 商务部：加强无人机相关两用物项对美国出口管制
headlines.summary: 根据《中华人民共和国出口管制法》和《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》等法律法规有关规定，为维护国家安全和利益、履行防扩散等国际义务，决定加强无人机相关两用物项对美国出口管制。现将有关事项公告如下：对列入《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单》的无人机及其关键零部件、相关技术对美国出口，逐案从严审核，不适用许可便利措施。本公告自公布之日起正式实施。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Strengthen export controls on US-bound dual-use items related to drones
headlines.summary_en: In accordance with the Export Control Law of the People's Republic of China and the Regulations on the Export Control of Dual-Use Items of the People's Republic of China and other relevant laws and regulations, and in order to safeguard national security and interests and fulfill international obligations such as non-proliferation, it is decided to strengthen export controls on UAV-related dual-use items to the United States. The following is hereby announced: for UAVs and their key components and related technologies listed in the Dual-Use Items Export Control List of the People's Republic of China, exports to the U.S. will be subject to strict case-by-case review and will not be eligible for licensing facilitation measures. This announcement shall take effect from the date of publication.
